correctness.rationale: A shortest cube path flips each used coordinate once; a path of length less than four extends along an unused coordinate. Thus the maximal geodesics are exactly the 192 unoriented antipodal paths. I generated their masks and marked every subset contained in a path complement by a Boolean subset transform; the unmarked masks are exactly the transversals. In ascending cardinality I marked the whole upset of each newly found inclusion-minimal set; the complete census and minimal census agree coefficient by coefficient with the frozen T and M, including totals 22499 and 460. For components I used the cover of the budgeted graph by upper stars of its inclusion-minimal sets: a star is connected by adding vertices from its root; two stars intersect exactly if their root union fits the cap; and every legal edge lies in a star because the smaller endpoint contains a minimal set. This independent component computation gave exactly 40 singleton components at 6, 160 singletons and 40 size-11 components at 7, 260 singletons and one size-3250 component at 8, and one component of size 9430 at 9. The budget-seven minima have ten neighbors each, and no two share a seven-set, so those components are stars. At budget eight, the singleton components are precisely the minimal eight-sets, so all forty six-sets connect. There are no minimal sets larger than eight, so any additional states at higher budgets can delete down into the connected budget-nine graph without violating feasibility. For optimum distances, I removed the eight-set vertices and replaced each feasible 7–8–7 segment between distinct seven-sets by an edge of weight two, keeping six–seven edges at weight one; this preserves distances between six-sets by expansion of the edges. Exact shortest paths in that graph reproduce the histogram (4:60, 6:160, 8:480, 12:80).
residual_risks: These are exact finite results for Q4, maximal geodesics and single-vertex addition/removal with the stated cap. The counts and distances need not extend to larger cubes or other move rules.

value.rationale: The four-cube is a standard small benchmark with already classified minimum covers. Under the natural detector addition/removal constraint, this result shows a real difference between mobility among the most economical configurations and mobility among all admissible configurations: isolated saturated minimal covers persist after the optima connect, and allowed relaxation of the cap first increases the component count. The exact constrained optimum metric quantifies the necessary detours; neither that metric nor the distinct thresholds is just a relabeling of the prior optimum census.
residual_risks: The significance is the sharp phenomenon in this natural finite benchmark, not evidence for a systematic high-dimensional law or operational robustness beyond the specified move model.
